name: Elite
strategy: Achieve superior performance through disciplined attacks, careful execution, and technical proficiency.

commands.name: Veteran Spearhead
commands.effect: One friendly Unit gains +1 Attack and Accurate 2 on its next Engagement Attack this Phase.

commands.name: Find the Opening
commands.effect: Choose one visible enemy Unit. Worsen its Evade by one step against the next friendly Attack targeting it this Phase. If the target has no Evade, that Attack gains Accurate 1 instead.

commands.name: Perfect Technique
commands.effect: After one friendly Unit rolls to Hit, reroll up to two failed Hit dice. Dice already rerolled cannot be selected.

commands.name: Combat Training
commands.effect: Choose one friendly Unit. Its next Attack this Round gains Accurate 2 and ignores one step of Hit worsening caused by a temporary condition.

commands.name: Knightly Order
commands.effect: One friendly Unit gains Charge 1 on its next Charge this Phase. If the Charge succeeds, its first Engagement Attack against that enemy this Round gains Accurate 2.

doctrineIdentity: Reliable, high-quality combat performance. Elite emphasizes making existing Attacks more effective. Alpha Strike produces larger opening attacks, while Counter Strike and Castling provide more dedicated defensive tools.
